data.message: All 24 others: individually opt into 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, leaving 250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Each switch earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but lowers reserves by 8 and low-outcome stock by 16. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't binding.
